title: IronPact: Round 5 Starts Now!
author: Standard_Text480
selftext:
[https://ironpact.applikuapp.com/](https://ironpact.applikuapp.com/)

Hello, IronPact is a persistent modem military themed browser strategy game with rounds lasting 1 month. 

Select a specialty (Warhawk, Isolationist, Economist, Miner)

Work together with your fellow countrymen to build and dominate as the strongest country in the world.

Research new tanks, aircraft missiles, and buildings. Combine your resources to construct country mega projects.

Use diplomacy to declare war, sign non aggression pacts, trade, and backstab every opportunity.

Our player base has grown significantly over the last 5 months as we continue to roll out major updates every round. We will see you on the battlefield!
